articles.title: Indonesian Navy welcomes nation's first submarine rescue vessel
articles.summary: The Indonesian Navy has commissioned its first submarine rescue vessel, KRI Canopus-936, in Jakarta. This crucial addition significantly enhances Indonesia's capability for underwater search and rescue operations, ensuring crew safety and operational readiness. The vessel's induction marks a major stride in bolstering Indonesia's naval defence infrastructure and contributes to regional maritime security.

articles.title: Microsoft-G42 Kenya data centre stalls over government offtake demands
articles.summary: Negotiations between a major company and the Kenyan government for a significant project have failed. The company sought a guaranteed annual capacity offtake, but the government declined to commit at the requested level. This breakdown in talks has stalled the project, potentially impacting Kenya's technological infrastructure and development plans.

articles.title: Salman Khan Celebrates Mother’s Day 2026 With Adorable Throwback Pictures With Mom Salma Khan and Helen (View Post)
articles.summary: Bollywood actor Salman Khan celebrated Mother's Day by sharing a nostalgic childhood photograph on social media. He posted an adorable snap on Instagram featuring his younger self with his mother, Salma Khan, alongside a heartfelt message. The post quickly went viral, attracting widespread attention and wishes from fans and fellow celebrities, becoming a trending topic nationwide.
